title: BOX
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: All values in the input are integers.; 2 \le N \le 3 \times 10^5; 1 \le Q \le 3 \times 10^5; For each type-1 operation, 1 \le X,Y \le N and X \neq Y.; For each type-2 operation, 1 \le X \le N.; For each type-3 operation, ball X is contained in some box at that point.; There is at least one type-3 operation.
